about.text: European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology is one of the most prestigious higher education institutions. EU Global is globally renowned for its innovation, world-class education, and focus on research. EU Global offers a wide range of programs that range from bachelor’s degrees to doctoral courses. It fosters lifelong learning through online and blended modes. Students can attend their classes from anywhere in the world.

EU Global offers a curriculum and coursework that is relevant to the global industries. It ensures that the students get access to global employability in an ever-changing job market through the knowledge and expertise provided by the institute. EU Global aims to empower learners to make meaningful and responsible contributors to society through its diverse courses. The courses provided by EU Global are supported by extremely experienced and highly qualified faculty members. The institute offers a collaborative learning environment with digital learning and real-world experiences.

European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology has top Europen Licensed Accreditations. It is accredited by the Malta Further & Higher Education Authority (MFHEA), the Maltese Qualifications Framework (MQF), and the European Qualifications Framework (EQF). EU Global is recognized by the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) and Bologna process. Moreover, the programs pursued by this institute are recognized by the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS).

EU Global offers equal opportunity to all its learners in a highly responsible and empathetic environment. Students from different cultures and ethnicities get diverse learning opportunities with innovation and ownership. The institute believes in Being Human and Diversity and offers opportunities for global careers in rapidly evolving industries.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology (EU Global) acknowledges the financial burden of students in paying their course fees through numerous EMI and Educational Loan Facilities. Although the fee structure at EU Global is highly affordable, many students may still find it difficult to make one-time payments. Students can avail the EMI and Educational loan facilities to pay their fees in easy installments. These facilities by EU Global encourage students to pay full attention to their studies.

admission.text: The admission process at the European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology (EU Global) can be completed online without going to the physical campus. Here is the detailed admission process-
Online Application Submission- The admission process for EU Global begins with the submission of online application forms. Here are the steps to submit the application form-
Step 1- Visit the official website of EU Global.
Step 2- Navigate and select the admission section.
Step 3- Select the program you are interested in.
Step 4- Select the registration option to generate the login ID and password.
Step 5- Login through the ID and password generated.
Step 6- Fill out the application form by providing the information required by EU Global.
Step 7- Attach the required documents and submit the form.
Step 8- Select the payment option and proceed with the payment of application fees.
Step 9- Approve the payment mandate to pay the fees.
Step 10- Save and take a printout of the acknowledgment slip for future reference.

Application Review- The admission committee of the EU Global will thoroughly review the application form once it has been finally submitted. The committee will ensure that the application form meets all the basic requirements and applicant fulfills the minimum eligibility requirements.
Personal Interview- Once the application review has been completed, the candidates will be invited for a personal interview. This may or may not be applicable based on the course.
Admission Offer- Candidates shortlisted in the personal interview, get admission offers from the EU Global Admission Committee. Candidates have to pay the admission fees to secure admission.

examination.text: The assessment of the students at the European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology (EU Global) is done on various parameters. The students at EU Global are evaluated based on written tests, assignments, project work, case studies, and many more. The students enrolled in doctorate programs at EU Global are evaluated on different parameters. They have to go through coursework, comprehensive examinations, original research, and viva voice.

faqs.q: What are the programs offered by the European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology (EU Global)?
faqs.a: European Global Institute of Innovation and Technology (EU Global) offers a wide range of courses at Bachelor’s, Master’s, and doctorate levels.

faqs.q: Is EU Global an approved institution?
faqs.a: Yes, EU Global has a wide range of European Licensed Accreditations and is recognized by the European Qualifications Framework (EQF). Moreover, it is an international member of the Association of Professional Higher Education Institutes, USA.

faqs.q: Does EU Global offer an Online DBA Course?
faqs.a: Yes, EU Global offers Online DBA Courses in a wide range of specializations.

faqs.q: What are the modes of study at EU Global?
faqs.a: EU Global offers online, blended, and on-campus programs.
